module Main (main) where

import Data.List (foldl')

main :: IO ()
main = do
  input <- getContents
  let (nLine:rest) = lines input
      n = read nLine :: Int
      xs = take n (map read (words (unwords rest))) :: [Int]
      (best, _) = foldl' step (x0, x0) (tail xs)
      x0 = head xs
      step (b, c) x = let c' = max x (c + x) in (max b c', c')
  print best
```

Note: `step` and `x0` usage requires the where-clause ordering fix:
